ns2:section.sectionText: Course is for Information Science majors providing a more in-depth exploration, engagement, and development within the iSchool. It is preferred students have already completed IS 100, but instructor approval may be provided if courses are taken concurrently. Always restricted to declared Information Sciences Majors. May be repeated (limit of 3 experiential hours count towards IS electives). For more information about this major, please visit: http://go.ischool.illinois.edu/BSIS. Questions may be sent to bsis-advising@illinois.edu.
ns2:section.sectionCappArea: Not intended for First Time Freshman students.
ns2:section.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Information Sciences department.
